answer: Thus, every alias costs 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the mirror record exposes exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the dawn queue naming the anchor that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
